lines.en: It's pub-trivia night again, which means that Rika is ten times more animated than her already highly-animated self. Which also means that we all have to suffer.
lines.zh: 又到了酒吧问答之夜，这意味着 Rika 会比她本就极度亢奋的状态还要亢奋十倍。这也意味着我们所有人都得遭罪。

lines.en: She winds up selecting me as a partner, leaving Imani to fend for herself while she pretends not to care. And surely enough, Rika smashes the competition.
lines.zh: 她最后选了我当搭档，把 Imani 丢下自生自灭，而 Imani 则装作毫不在意。果不其然，Rika 把对手们打得落花流水。

lines.en: I still don't understand where this strange bank of useless knowledge comes from. But considering how far behind she is in terms of common sense, I guess she needed to excel at {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 我到现在也不明白她那套奇怪的无用知识库是从哪来的。不过考虑到她在常识方面落后得多，我想她总得在{i}某件事{/i}上出类拔萃吧。

lines.en: And you know what? I'm glad it's this. Because it's refreshing sitting beside someone who knows more about ancient pyramids than the evils that men do.
lines.zh: 你知道吗？我很庆幸是这件事。因为坐在一个人身边，她了解古代金字塔多过了解人类所作的恶，这让人耳目一新。

lines.en: And as an evil man who will receive no golden sarcophagus nor tomb of any sort, that puts me at ease.
lines.zh: 而作为一个既得不到黄金人形棺、也得不到任何陵墓的恶人，这让我安心不少。

lines.en: Just not enough {i}ease{/i} to discount the fact that I am, once again, unintentionally the center of attention.
lines.zh: 只是这份{i}安心{/i}还不足以抹消一个事实：我又一次无意间成了众人瞩目的焦点。

lines.en: Once the trivia game comes to an end, the rest of the girls head outside while Rika and I elect to stay in.
lines.zh: 问答游戏一结束，其他女孩都出去了，而 Rika 和我选择留在里面。

lines.en: She congratulates me on a job well done despite me having done no job at all, and I congratulate her for the impressive defeat of several intellectuals in a battle of...intellect.
lines.zh: 她祝贺我干得漂亮，尽管我什么都没干；我也祝贺她在一场……智力的比拼中，令人印象深刻地击败了好几位知识分子。

lines.en: She gets confused when I word it that way, but I don't care.
lines.zh: 我这么措辞让她有些困惑，但我不在乎。

lines.en: Because regardless of what she knows or how she came to know it, she's a good person. And at the end of the day, that's more than most of us can say about ourselves.
lines.zh: 因为不管她知道些什么、又是怎么知道的，她都是个好人。说到底，这已经比我们大多数人能对自己的评价要高了。
